verdicts.reason: A: the two-line quote is barely legible at 320x50, and the bold yellow attribution is as loud as the quote, which flattens the hierarchy. The quote mark is crammed into the top-left corner, the attribution sits below and to the left of the quote with no shared edge, the product is shrunk to an unreadable sliver on the right, and the Solstice logo is missing. B: the quote is squeezed onto one line at microscopic size and the letter-spaced attribution is illegible. The quote mark is a speck against the left edge, the product and circles are crushed into the bottom-right corner, the logo is lost and most of the banner is empty, so it reads even worse than A.
